authority: House Tang Bastion Corps combat establishments. Technical/support work is commanded temporary duty from corps manpower, not permanent support troop classes.

command_accounting.rule: A persistent maneuver formation may contain multiple troop roles. Its top commander and deputy are outside stated troop strength. Embedded 1,000/500/100 command echelons are bodies within the role components they command; aggregate representation never adds extra manpower.

qualification_regimen.rule: Full-time Bastion induction/specialist training uses the same universal active/enrolled 48-hour-per-seven-day deliberate clock as every other professional military path. Bastion advantage comes from registered specialist curriculum, instructors, facilities, equipment and selection, not extra calendar time; hours accrue only while the candidate occupies physical Bastion training capacity.

recruitment.emergency_rule: Emergency militia remain militia until they complete the applicable Corps qualification path.
recruitment.forecast_rule: This is a planning forecast for training-pipeline depth, not an automatic retirement/death rate. Actual separations remain causal; unused qualified candidates remain conserved reserved people until admitted or released.

outside_applicant_runtime.conservation_rule: Bodies leave an exact source civilian locality, travel through the population-mobility owner, and enter Tang Manor civilian population on arrival before any candidate reservation or Corps transfer.
outside_applicant_runtime.guarantee_rule: Relocation guarantees residence and consideration eligibility only. It never guarantees selection, training completion, rank, billet, or active-service appointment.
sequence: admission only into a real vacancy

recruitment.ownership_rule: Applicants become permanent House Tang service personnel, never contract mercenaries.
recruitment.replacement_rule: Forecast vacancies from retirement, death, disability, lawful departure, and authorized expansion; recruit early enough that training pipelines can overlap expected vacancies.
source_priority: Tang Manor civilians for future normal replacement/expansion
lawful outside applicants who permanently relocate to Tang Manor
recruitment.throughput_rule: Training throughput is derived from instructors, barracks, ranges, workshops, practice works, equipment, food, and time. No arbitrary monthly recruitment cap is authoritative.

retirement.body_rule: Due aggregate rank-and-file return to Tang Manor civilian veteran strata. The same force loses those bodies and gains vacancies; no replacement is created by retirement.
retirement.cadre_rule: Surviving earned officer grades remain attached to the formation/corps unless explicitly retired, transferred, promoted, demoted, or killed.
retirement.named_person_rule: Named/person-lite/full officers retire only through explicit career/service events; aggregate retirement never silently removes them.
